basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production riverbank texture for a realistic isometric city-building game. Create a wide 3:1 image, 3072x1024 if possible, a directly overhead orthographic view of ONE continuous river shoreline strip representing 48 metres horizontally and 16 metres vertically. This is the ground artwork itself, no layout, no border, no labels. Upper 35 percent lush dense olive meadow grass with varied clumps and tiny flowers; middle irregular shore of tan soil, gravel, rounded pale grey and warm brown rocks in organic clusters, a few larger distinct rocks and sedge tufts; bottom 30 percent dark wet fine pebbles and riverbed, NO WATER rendered because game supplies real animated water. Grass fingers extend irregularly down among rock patches. Several large patches of gravel alternating with greener grassy spits. All scene viewed exactly from above with no perspective or horizon. Even diffuse daylight, subtle local contact shadows only. No paths, no manmade objects, no text, no black outlines. Full composition will wrap along a river curve across many game tiles; do not make a tile atlas.
